title: Sparkle before 2.9.6 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the installer's SPUInstallationData…
description: A time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition exists in Sparkle versions before 2.9.6 in the installer's SPUInstallationData handling. The installer validates the symlink-resolved download URL but performs the privileged move operation on the unresolved URL and only checks the file type afterward. This allows a local user to swap an intermediate directory in the download path with a symlink between the check and the move, causing the installer running with elevated privileges to rename files outside the intended protected location, leading to privilege escalation.
